page.overview:
Who is Jeb Marsh?

Jeb Marsh is a character created by American author Armand Rosamilia for his Keyport Cthulhu series of Mythos stories. He made his first appearance in the short story "Ancient" in 2012.

A distant descendant of the Innsmouth Marshes, Jeb carries the curse of his blood and is now almost completely inhuman. Upon his change, the Keyport branch of the Esoteric Order of Dagon locked him up in his secluded cottage, likely due to their belief that he was not of a like mind with them. However, he has managed to tunnel his way through the basement, and is now able to come and go as he pleases. It is implied that he roams the streets of Keyport at night, attempting to help those who might fall victim to the monstrous creatures which lurk beneath the town.

Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Other Supernatural Beings
